Now let me plan the IPHC header and the full payload:

IPHC header (2 bytes):
- First byte: 0x60 | (bits for traffic class/flow label/next header/hop limit)
  - kHcDispatch = 3 << 13, so first byte of 16-bit dispatch: 0x60 | other bits
  - kHcTrafficClass (1 << 11): if set, traffic class is elided (compressed)
  - kHcFlowLabel (2 << 11): if set, flow label is elided
  - Together (3 << 11): both elided
  - kHcNextHeader (1 << 10): if set, next header is compressed using NHC
  - kHcHopLimit255 (3 << 8): hop limit = 255 inline

Let me use:
- Traffic class and flow label both elided: kHcTrafficClass | kHcFlowLabel = 3 << 11 = 0x1800
  In the 16-bit IPHC field: 0x6000 | 0x1800 | other_bits
  First byte: 0x60 | 0x18 = 0x78... no wait.

Wait, the 16-bit IPHC dispatch/encoding field:
bits 15-13: 011 (dispatch = 3 << 13)
bit 12-11: TF (traffic class/flow label compression)
  00 = inline (4 bytes)
  01 = traffic class + 3-byte flow label elided to ECN+flow (3 bytes)
  10 = traffic class inline, flow label elided (1 byte)
  11 = traffic class and flow label fully elided (0 bytes)
bit 10: NH (next header)
  0 = next header inline (1 byte)
  1 = next header compressed using NHC
bits 9-8: HLIM (hop limit)
  00 = inline (1 byte)
  01 = 1
  10 = 64
  11 = 255
bit 7: CID (context identifier extension)
  0 = no additional 8-bit CID
  1 = 8-bit CID follows
bit 6: SAC (source address compression)
  0 = stateless
  1 = stateful (context-based)
bits 5-4: SAM (source address mode)
  With SAC=0:
  00 = 128-bit inline
  01 = 64-bit (link-local fe80::...)
  10 = 16-bit (link-local fe80::ff:fe00:XXXX)
  11 = 0-bit (link-local from MAC)
bit 3: M (multicast)
  0 = not multicast
  1 = multicast
bit 2: DAC (destination address compression)
  0 = stateless
  1 = stateful
bits 1-0: DAM (destination address mode)
  With M=0, DAC=0:
  00 = 128-bit inline
  01 = 64-bit inline
  10 = 16-bit inline
  11 = from MAC

So for our purposes:
- TF = 11 (fully elided) -> bits 12-11 = 11
- NH = 1 (next header compressed, will use UDP NHC) -> bit 10 = 1
- HLIM = 11 (255) -> bits 9-8 = 11
- CID = 0 -> bit 7 = 0
- SAC = 0 (stateless) -> bit 6 = 0
- SAM = 11 (from MAC, but we have no source MAC... hmm)
